verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that SendGrid authenticates with an API key (sgMail.setApiKey). Nothing documents scoped, restricted, or least-privilege API keys. Mentions of EU regional subusers and sub-accounts are adjacent account structures, not documented per-credential permission scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
